full_page.content:
Bles'd be God in all His designs! July 5th
God bless you Maurice O'Connell, you and yours.
Many thanks for your favor of April 29. Please pardon delayed ac- knowledgement. Thank the good God for your improvement reported. May He continue to brighten things for you. The holy Masses have been solved. I am sending you herewith something will, I hope be satisfac- tory in place of what you ask.
Sincerely yours in Christ
Fr. Solanus O.F.M. Cap.
P.S. Am opening envelope to incert card. - "more haste less speed !. "
